title: Drive API clarifies concurrent permission warnings
summary: The Google Drive API's documentation for permission management methods (`delete`, `insert`, `patch`, `update`) has been updated. The warning regarding concurrent operations now explicitly includes folders, shared drives, and clarifies that modifications apply across all users and clients.
details: The `permissions.delete`, `permissions.insert`, `permissions.patch`, and `permissions.update` methods in the Drive API now feature a more precise warning in their descriptions. The previous warning about 'Concurrent permissions operations on the same file' has been expanded to 'Concurrent permission modifications (such as update or delete) on the same file, folder, or shared drive aren't supported across any users or clients; only the last update is applied.' This clarification emphasizes the broader scope of the concurrency limitation.
